records.subject: spec-guard-0.57.0-claude-copy
evidence: result:all run green from the installed copy (phase-guard 249 cases, verify-artifacts 52 cases, review marker 20 tests); spec-digest.py --selftest passes

result:12 of 16 pass, including the new review-marker test; the other 4 error because they read repository files outside the plugin package (docs/workflow.md, .github/pull_request_template.md), which Claude's installed layout does not carry -- the installed 0.56.0 copy gives the same 4 errors, so this is not a change in 0.57.0

result:in a temporary project, the same three states on the installed 0.56.0 and 0.57.0 copies: Spec pending without a Plan -- 0.56.0 suggests creating the Plan, 0.57.0 prints the Review line and "wait for the user to review"; Plan pending with open todo items -- 0.56.0 suggests continuing the build, 0.57.0 prints the Review line and "do not continue the build"; both approved -- 0.57.0 adds the Next gate line naming the first unchecked gate checkpoint and skipping the report one
result:after the approved Spec was edited, the installed verify-artifacts warns that the Spec was revised after approval and exits without a failure
